_what_this_is: The documents whose k-gram frequencies define 'common' for F1.3 rarity weighting. Globs are expanded in sorted order and each FILE is one document; document frequency is the number of documents a k-gram appears in. See README.md for the construction rule and its limits.
_never: corpus/negative/held-out.json is NOT here and must never be: the published false-positive figure is measured on that half, and a background containing it would be scoring the matcher against material it had already been shown.

excluded.docs/*.md: the documentation of this experiment quotes the exact literal runs the negative families share, so including it would put the answer in the background
excluded.corpus/context/*: the bait files carry planted canaries, and a background that contained a canary would weight our own markers down to nothing, which is the one thing the corpus plants them to be able to find
